cultural.vision_reason: The photo documents a named South Piegan (Blackfeet) chief, Big Spring, and his wife in full traditional dress (feather headdress, decorated hide shirt, leggings, and beaded cloth dress) outdoors in Montana — a clear documentary photo of the claimed people's attire and life.

physical.classification: photographic print (black and white); glass negative
physical.summary:
Glass negative (black and white); a photograph of a cutting from a  newspaper or magazine of a South Piegan Chief, Big Spring, and his wife posing outdoors; Big Spring wears a feather headdress, necklaces, decorated hide shirt and leggings, loin covering and moccasins; his wife wears a brimmed felt hat, a cloth scarf around her neck and decorated cloth dress with beadwork and  horizontal strips of cloth; Montana, United States of America.
